impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates UP. A fall pushes them DOWN.

chains.chain: Headline CPI → ↑ Inflation expectations → ↑ 10Y Treasury → ↑ MBS yield → ↑ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: Headline feeds expectations but is discounted for energy noise.
The 10Y is a real yield plus an inflation expectation. Expectations move the nominal.
MBS are priced off the Treasury curve. This is the main channel.
Lenders price off MBS execution, with a short lag for rate sheets.
